name: Workbench Tab Title Dialog
description: Edits one stable terminal Tab title and exposes the empty-title restore behavior through the shared Workbench resource form.

states: Use the active Tab shortcut to inspect the prefilled and selected current title.
Submit a custom title, then reopen, clear, and submit to restore the terminal title.

useWhen: A Workbench terminal Tab needs a user-owned title override that survives terminal title updates.
A person needs to clear the override and return ownership to terminal-reported title metadata.
avoidWhen: The editable identity belongs to a Project, Workspace, Tab group, or terminal process rather than one terminal Tab.
The caller cannot preserve and revalidate a stable terminal-context and Tab identity through submission.
invariants: Opening captures the exact terminal-context and Tab identity together with the effective title shown at that moment.
Submitting revalidates the captured target and never redirects the edit to a newly active Tab.
An empty or whitespace-only submission clears the custom title and restores the latest terminal-reported fallback title.
Canceling closes the editor without mutating title policy, and focus returns through the modal lifecycle.
